SEC. 2405. AUTHORIZATION OF CERTAIN FISCAL YEAR 2018 PROJECT.

    The table in section 2401(a) of the National Defense Authorization 
Act for Fiscal Year 2018 (division B of Public Law 105-91) is amended by
